_comment: Optional per-heartbeat watch commands for the Ateles codex_turn_guard. The guard hashes each command's output; an idle heartbeat is blocked only while every hash is unchanged. argv is run without a shell, read-only, 6 s each, 12 s in total. base_s and cap_s set the back-off window after a quiet run (doubles per consecutive quiet run, up to cap_s).
